title: 第一章 叮，您的系统已到账~
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当伊尔莎跑出森林的时候，却绝望地发现，面前是深不见底的悬崖。

而身后，数十名身着重铠的魔族禁卫军正从森林中走出，将她团团包围。

伊尔莎银白的长发在风中飞舞着，衣裙上满是泥浆，那原本精致白净的脸颊上也都是污泥，瘦小的肩膀在奔跑后的喘息中起伏着。

她握紧了手中断裂的长剑，红宝石般的眼眸中满是不甘。

最终还是沦落至此。

这场皇位争夺战，自己终究还是失败了，她的兄长也不愿给她留一丝退路，所有和她有关的眷属都将要赶尽杀绝，自己也在逃亡的途中被追击而来的禁卫军截住，逼迫到如此地步。

所有侍从全部遇害，只留下她一人垂死挣扎。

禁卫军中走出了生长着硕大双角的魔族卫队长，拖着那把带着血迹的齿牙剑，每走一步重甲都发出锵锵之声，朝着伊尔莎一步步踏来。

“皇女殿下，如果现在束手就擒，我们还能给你一个体面。”他沉声说道。

伊尔莎咬牙，面对那体型三倍高于她的卫队长，没有屈服，举起了手中的断剑，眼神冷得可怕。

“我会死去，但决不会丢掉剑，跪在地上屈辱地任人宰割！”

她厉声喝道，带着视死如归的决然。

对此卫队长只是冷哼一声，接着，对她抬起了巨齿剑。

伊尔莎咬紧牙关，紧握剑柄，准备最后的殊死抵抗。

但就在这时，她的脑中，突然响起了一道声音：

“叮~您的系统已到账，请问宿主是否绑定？”

伊尔莎坚定的脸庞一僵，怀疑自己是不是幻听。

但，这个声音再一次，清晰地出现在了她的脑海。

“本系统为秒杀系统，请问宿主是否出卖自己身体来绑定系统，本系统将提供瞬间秒杀任意目标的服务。”

“这是...邪神的低语吗？”

伊尔莎听过这个传说，当一个人走投无路的时候，邪神就会出现，诱导其出卖身体换取罪恶的救赎。

而且还会说一些自己无法理解的语言。

“我...”

伊尔莎本觉得自己绝不会做这种出卖灵魂的事，但是，眼下的情况还会好到哪里去呢？

她在被杀死后，尸体会被吊在皇城脚下，还会被描绘成弑父屠母的千古罪人，受到所有子民的唾弃。

那样连她的灵魂都将变得污秽。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Ilsa ran out of the forest, she found in despair that there was a bottomless cliff in front of her.

Behind her, dozens of demon guards wearing heavy armor were walking out of the forest, surrounding her.

Ilsa's silver-white hair was flying in the wind, her dress was covered with mud, her originally delicate and fair cheeks were also covered in mud, and her thin shoulders were heaving as she panted after running.

She clenched the broken sword in her hand, her ruby ​​eyes full of unwillingness.

In the end, it fell to this.

In this battle for the throne, she failed after all. Her brother was not willing to leave a way for her to retreat. All the family members related to her were about to be exterminated. On the way to escape, she was intercepted by the pursuing guards and forced to this point.

All the attendants were killed, leaving only her dying.

The captain of the Demon Guard with huge horns walked out of the Imperial Guard, dragging the blood-stained tooth sword, and the heavy armor made a clanging sound with every step he took, and walked towards Ilsa step by step.

"Your Royal Highness, if you surrender now, we can still give you dignity." He said in a deep voice.

Ilsa gritted her teeth. Facing the guard captain who was three times taller than her, she did not give in. She raised the broken sword in her hand with terrifyingly cold eyes.

"I will die, but I will never throw away my sword and kneel on the ground to be slaughtered in humiliation!"

She shouted sternly, with a determination that looked down upon death.

The captain of the guard just snorted coldly, and then raised his giant-toothed sword towards her.

Ilsa gritted her teeth and gripped the hilt of her sword, preparing for the final desperate resistance.

But at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded in her head:

"Ding~ Your system has received the account. Is it bound to the host?"

Ilsa's determined face froze, wondering if she was hearing something.

But, this voice appeared clearly in her mind again.

"This system is an instant kill system. I would like to ask the host if he would sell his body to bind the system. This system will provide a service that instantly kills any target."

"Is this...the whisper of the evil god?"

Ilsa had heard this legend. When a person is desperate, the evil god will appear and induce him to sell his body in exchange for redemption from sin.

And he also speaks some languages ​​that he cannot understand.

"I..."

Ilsa thought that she would never do such a thing of selling her soul, but how could the current situation be any better?

After she was killed, her body would be hung at the foot of the imperial city. She would also be portrayed as an eternal sinner who killed her father and mother, and was spurned by all her people.

Even her soul would become filthy.
